description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity is ideal for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. You will be instrumental in guiding our facility's strategic direction, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will oversee all aspects of facility operations, including clinical services, financial management, and human resources. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and forward-thinking organization. We are looking for a leader who can inspire teams, drive quality outcomes, and maintain a strong commitment to community well-being. Compensation for this vital role is competitive, reflecting your expertise and leadership capabilities.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a similar leadership capacity within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Proven track record in financial management, operational oversight, and staff development.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
An exciting opportunity awaits a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) in Frostburg, MD. Join a premier health and rehabilitation center committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This role is ideal for a compassionate and experienced nursing professional ready to take on a leadership challenge.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in assisting the Director of Nursing with the overall management of the nursing department. Your responsibilities will include overseeing daily operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and maintaining high standards of clinical care. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to enhance our clinical leadership team.

This position offers a competitive annual salary, reflecting your valuable experience and dedication to patient well-being. We are seeking a leader who can inspire and guide our nursing staff, contributing to a positive and effective care delivery system.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a supervisory role
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and best practices
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $75,000 to $90,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier community health center in Greenville, SC, committed to providing comprehensive family medicine services. This role offers an exceptional compensation package designed to reward your expertise and commitment, including a competitive base salary and significant bonus opportunities. We value work-life balance, offering great benefits and generous Paid Time Off.

We are seeking a skilled and compassionate Family Medicine Physician to contribute to our patient-centered care model. While full-time is preferred, we are open to considering all qualified Physician candidates, including those seeking part-time, PRN, or contract arrangements, offering flexibility to suit your lifestyle. This is an excellent opportunity for physicians looking for a dynamic environment with a strong focus on community health.

We welcome candidates open to travel or relocation, and our revamped compensation structure is highly competitive, exceeding the average for family physicians in South Carolina. If you are an MD or DO passionate about family medicine, internal medicine, or med/ped, and are looking for a role with substantial earning potential and a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
salaryShort: $210,000+ per year with up to $50,000 in bonuses
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped
Current, unrestricted medical license in South Carolina (or ability to obtain)
Experience in an outpatient or community health setting is a plus
salaryOrBonusInfo: Base salary of $210,000 per year. This role includes a robust bonus structure of up to $50,000, comprising a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and a $25,000 potential bonus. $9,000 of the bonus is available as a sign-on bonus, with a portion payable on day one upon signing a promissory note. Please note, relocation bonuses are not offered.
